items.title: Is Eaton Stock Amplifying A Risk You Already Own?
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) makes the power equipment that goes inside data centers, among much else, and it has climbed 5.0% over the last five trading days while the S&P 500 slipped 0.2%. A run like that pulls money in. The question worth answering is not where the stock goes from here. It is what owning Eaton does to the rest of your money every time the market moves, and it moves further than the index in both directions.

items.title: Should You Buy Howmet Stock After Its Turbine Blade Scare?
items.summary: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) has fallen about 21% from its August high, and the question is whether that is a gift or a warning. Its own record says falls this size have paid off more often than not, and that you will probably watch it fall further first. What knocked the stock down is a scare about who else might make turbine blades. Start with what the record paid.

items.title: Wall Street Sees a Multibillion-Dollar Humanoid Robot Market. These 2 Suppliers Get Paid Either Way.
items.summary: Hesai Group is dominant in lidar sensors, and Parker-Hannifin is a provider of key components.

items.title: Parker-Hannifin Stock: Is PH Outperforming the Industrial Sector?
items.summary: Parker-Hannifin has outperformed the Industrial sector over the past year, and analysts are highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: 1 Large-Cap Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Question
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

items.title: Eaton Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Factory Ramp
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) trades near $390 a share, about 39.7 times the adjusted earnings it made over the past twelve months. That basis is normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, meant to sit closer to the analyst-consensus basis than a GAAP figure would, though the two adjusted measures are not defined identically. On that figure alone the stock looks dear. But it prices a year Eaton has already finished.

items.title: S&P 500 Pulls Back From Lows, Dow Sinks
items.summary: Stocks pared more dramatic losses seen earlier in the session, but were still trading lower. The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.8% as the S&P 500 dropped 0.5%. The indexes were down as much as 1.4% and 0.8%, respectively.

items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks With So Much Cash Flow Their Payouts Barely Make a Dent
items.summary: Chasing the highest yield is usually how income investors get burned, but these three NYSE industrials take a different approach that makes their dividend safety almost unfair to competitors.
